ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (OneTwoPunch.cs:17-20) == cost 1 / SKILL / RARE / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DynamicVar("Attacks", 1m)` (OneTwoPunch.cs:15) == `_attacks = 1`. `_attacks` is in `Card._MAGIC_ATTRS` (cards/base.py:185-189) so `magic_number` surfaces it -- the correct storage for a named non-standard var, contrast card/normality's inlined threshold.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<OneTwoPunchPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["Attacks"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (OneTwoPunch.cs:24) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, OneTwoPunchPower, self._attacks, applier=ctx.player)`. No animation on either side. OneTwoPunchPower is one of the two `modify_card_play_count` powers (powers.py:966 or 3919) the `replay` probe lists, so it is a SOURCE of gap G4's blast radius -- the power stream's to audit, but worth noting that card/drum_of_battle's bare `1` would also ignore a One-Two Punch stack, since Drum of Battle is a Skill and this power keys on Attacks.
